_about: Written by E-a after reading each program and the SHAP-style contributors in the E12 card. Keys are the first row id of a cluster (augmented copies of one mutant share a cluster).
A-002622: Q04 `contains` keeps a `found` flag and sets it back to 0 in the else branch, so only the last cell decides (D01, operator d01_else_flag_reset). In TRAIN every D01 row uses `else return` inside the loop (operator d01_else_return, Q01/Q08/Q12/Q15); d01_else_flag_reset exists only on this held-out problem. D01's own features that fired here (a_assign_in_loop_else, r_eq_first/last_check_only) are not the ones the model learned from `else return`, and the evidence for OTHER is generic (r_eq_zero=1, a_index_i_plus_1=0). Held-out surface form of a trained class, not a labelling error.
A-002623: Same mutant as A-002622 with the `if` braces dropped. Held-out operator d01_else_flag_reset on Q04; training D01 rows are all `else return` shapes.
A-002637: Same as A-002622 with a padding variable. Held-out operator d01_else_flag_reset; the extra variable does not change the evidence.
A-002658: Same flag reset as A-002622 written as a while loop. Held-out operator d01_else_flag_reset; not a loop-form problem.
A-002659: Same as A-002658 without braces. Held-out operator d01_else_flag_reset.
A-002673: Same as A-002658 with a padding variable. Held-out operator d01_else_flag_reset.
A-002701: Countdown loop with the D01 flag reset plus a debug `printf` in a function that does return. The model puts 5.2 SHAP units on a_printf_in_nonvoid into M10 (printed instead of returned), although the function returns `found`: a debug print next to a return is exactly the near-miss shape M10 should not fire on. The D01 signature (a_assign_in_loop_else) was seen only on this held-out problem.
A-003455: Q09 `second_largest` seeds `second` with `(a[0] > a[1]) ? a[1] : a[1]`, a constant-index slip (m08_first1). Only a_index_const1 points to M08 and the model gives it little weight; the winners are absence features (a_index_i_plus_1=0, b_status_timeout=0), so OTHER wins with low confidence (0.31 calibrated, 0.80 at T=1). Weak M08 surface on a held-out problem; the tests still fail, so OTHER is a fair 'something is wrong' answer.
A-003456: Same family as A-003455 (`(a[1] > a[1]) ? a[1] : a[0]`). Weak constant-index evidence, OTHER wins at low confidence.
A-004584: Q16 `sum_digits` recurses on `n % 10` instead of `n / 10` (d06_same_arg): the argument never shrinks towards the base for n >= 10 (it is stuck below 10, so the answer is wrong rather than looping). a_rec_arg_form_other=1 gives OTHER 2.6 SHAP units. TRAIN D06 rows (Q17, Q18) have the argument unchanged (`f(n)`) or growing (`f(n+1)`), which are the features D06 owns (a_rec_arg_form_same/plus1); none of them fires for `n % 10`, so the class's defining features are all silent here. Same operator id as in training, different surface form on the held-out problem.
A-004598: Same as A-004584 with a padding variable. D06's defining features did not fire; `n % 10` reads as 'other' argument form.
A-004631: Q16 with base case `n == 0` and `sum_digits(n % 10)`: the run hits the depth cap (b_depth_cap and b_rec_arg_constant fired, both D06 defining features) but a_rec_arg_form_other=1 adds 2.9 SHAP units to OTHER and wins. The trace evidence for D06 is present and is outvoted by the static argument form.
A-004645: Same as A-004631 with a padding variable. Trace signature of D06 present, static 'other' form outvotes it.
A-004692: Q16 with the recursive call stored in `rest` before the add. Same d06_same_arg mutant as A-004584: `n % 10` is an 'other' argument form, no D06 defining feature fires.
A-004706: Same as A-004692 with a padding variable.
RL-003: P05 `charge_steps`: the loop is `for (steps = 0; level < target; )` and `steps` is never advanced, but `level` advances through the helper `add_seven`, so the loop ends and the function returns 0. The LLM-written belief is M02 (variable advances by itself), yet the symptom is a wrong count, not a loop that never ends. M02's timeout signature (b_step_cap) is absent, the helper call hides the update from the AST features, and the model falls back to OTHER on generic evidence (r_eq_ref_n_plus_1=0.5, r_off_by_value_1=0.75). The label is the author's intended belief, not what the run shows.
RL-005: P03 `total_energy` rewritten as a `finished` flag loop that resets the total to 0 on every pass (M03). The flag loop takes one extra pass to notice the end, so b_iter_delta_const_pm1=1 (iterations = n+1) gives M01 2.6 SHAP units; M03's own signature (r_eq_ref_last_only: the total equals the last cell only) fired but weighs less. The sentinel-flag loop imitates an off-by-one bound.
RL-010: P11 `door_open` assigns inside a statement, `compareCheck = (code = 42)`, wrapped in a dummy `while (i < 1)` loop. M06's features (a_assign_in_cond, b_assign_in_cond_rt) look for an assignment inside an `if` condition and did not fire. The dummy loop gives an iteration-count mismatch (b_iter_delta_const_pm1=1), which reads as M01. Surface form of M06 the generator does not produce (m06_while_assign had no site, notes/C3.md).
RL-019: Q08 `is_sorted` has an empty `else` and sets `flag = 1` in both branches, so it always returns 1; labelled OTHER (relabelled from D01 in notes/T1.md). a_index_i_plus_1=1 gives M08 1.7 SHAP units: `a[i + 1]` with bound `i < n - 1` is the correct way to compare neighbours in this problem, but the feature cannot tell a legal neighbour read from M08's past-the-end read. A feature limit; the wrong behaviour (always true) has no class of its own, so OTHER is correct.
RL-030: Q18 `array_sum_rec` keeps the recursive result (`ans`) but returns it without adding `a[n-1]`, and has a debug `printf`. The label D07 (result of the recursive call not combined) is the author's intended belief. a_printf_in_nonvoid=1 gives M10 5.1 SHAP units: a debug print in a function that returns is the near-miss shape M10 should not fire on. D07's defining features (a_rec_call_discarded) are 0 because the call result is used.
RL-048: Q08 `is_sorted` with the comparison reversed (`a[i] < a[i + 1]` clears the flag) and a `break`; wrong answer, label OTHER. The break stops the loop early, so b_iter_delta_mean=-0.6 gives M01 1.9 SHAP units (loop ran fewer times than the reference), which is what M01 looks like for a loop that stops on purpose. The model has no way to separate 'stopped early because it found the answer' from 'bound too small'.
